title: PM Narendra Modi Outlines 7 National Appeals Under 'Nation First, Duty Above Comfort'
summary: PM Modi calls on citizens to curb gold & foreign travel, reduce fuel/edible oil usage, adoption of natural farming, and remote work amid West Asia crisis.

blocks.content: Addressing a public gathering in Secunderabad on May 10, 2026, PM Modi issued 7 economic self-reliance appeals to mitigate global West Asia oil shock impacts ($126/bbl crude spike).

provenance.sourceTitle: PM Narendra Modi Outlines 7 National Appeals Under 'Nation First, Duty Above Comfort'
